argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
Add-Type -AssemblyName UIAutomationClient
Add-Type -AssemblyName UIAutomationTypes
$desktop=[System.Windows.Automation.AutomationElement]::RootElement
$wins=$desktop.FindAll([System.Windows.Automation.TreeScope]::Children,[System.Windows.Automation.Condition]::TrueCondition)
$dlg=$null
for($i=0;$i -lt $wins.Count;$i++){
  $w=$wins.Item($i)
  $cls=[string]$w.Current.ClassName
  $name=[string]$w.Current.Name
  if($cls -eq '#32770' -or $name -match '開啟|Open|選取|檔案'){ $dlg=$w; break }
}
if($null -eq $dlg){throw 'No file picker dialog found'}
$all=$dlg.FindAll([System.Windows.Automation.TreeScope]::Descendants,[System.Windows.Automation.Condition]::TrueCondition)
$out=@()
for($i=0;$i -lt $all.Count;$i++){
  $e=$all.Item($i)
  $ct=$e.Current.ControlType.ProgrammaticName
  if($ct -match 'Edit|Button|ComboBox'){
    $r=$e.Current.BoundingRectangle
    $out += [pscustomobject]@{
      type=$ct
      name=[string]$e.Current.Name
      aid=[string]$e.Current.AutomationId
      class=[string]$e.Current.ClassName
      focusable=[bool]$e.Current.IsKeyboardFocusable
      enabled=[bool]$e.Current.IsEnabled
      has_focus=[bool]$e.Current.HasKeyboardFocus
      x=[string]$r.X;y=[string]$r.Y;w=[string]$r.Width;h=[string]$r.Height
      value_supported=[bool]$e.TryGetCurrentPattern([System.Windows.Automation.ValuePattern]::Pattern,[ref]([object]$null))
    }
  }
}
[pscustomobject]@{dialog_name=[string]$dlg.Current.Name;dialog_class=[string]$dlg.Current.ClassName;controls=$out}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 -Compress
